game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Lava River Crossing Defense
game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing, a river of molten rock: the volcanologist must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before cinder bats spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Lava River Crossing: a river of molten rock
core_gameplay_loop: In Lava River Crossing, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before cinder bats spring the trap. Each round, cinder bats strike the forge anvil, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the forge anvil from cinder bats in Lava River Crossing: keep the predictions meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 26-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: predictions drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 26-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 2 (intro tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how predictions changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against cinder bats in Lava River Crossing.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 26 seconds while predictions > 0.
